name: Ultegra splined bottom bracket
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 1998 reference: 221.5 g for the 68 mm-shell BB-6500 splined bottom bracket. The weight entry does not identify whether its spindle is the 109.5 mm double or 118.5 mm triple option; neither length is claimed as the weighed configuration.

technical_document.title: Shimano 1998 STI technical manual, PDF page 87 / printed page 86: exact BB-6500 model, separate double/triple spindle options and threaded-shell references

sources.title: Shimano 1998 STI technical manual, PDF page 87 / printed page 86: exact BB-6500 model, separate double/triple spindle options and threaded-shell references
Shimano 1998 STI technical manual, PDF page 59 / printed page 58: BB-6500 specification explicitly publishes 221.5 g for the 68 mm-shell reference; the weighed spindle option is unspecified
